about: North Cowichan is a district municipality in the Cowichan Valley on Vancouver Island, wrapping around the separate City of Duncan rather than forming a city of its own. Chemainus, Crofton, Maple Bay, and Westholme sit among farms, forested hills, and the Cowichan River. Chemainus is known for outdoor murals and a theatre festival. About 32,000 people live in North Cowichan.
